recommended_first_r1.rationale: r=1 shell on U_small stays in CP-SAT comfort; includes low-delta adds and high-pressure removers; enlarge only after scoped result.

spatial_halo.definition: Chebyshev ball around Rem∪Add or around high-pressure selected points
spatial_halo.role: recover local geometric neighbors missed by score cutoff

score_halo.definition: Next band of insertion-delta / removal-score candidates beyond U cutoffs
score_halo.suggested_expansion: add next 25–50% of ranked add list; next 25% rem list

blocker_graph_halo_future.definition: Graph-distance ≤ h in conflict/blocker incidence graph (Agent A)
blocker_graph_halo_future.role: capture non-local coupling RH-3; combine as U := U_score ∪ spatial_halo ∪ blocker_halo
blocker_graph_halo_future.warning: Do not interpret scoped UNSAT on any finite U as a global upper bound

halo_combination.combination_recipe: Start U_small spatial+score; if quick UNSAT, enlarge by blocker halo then score band then spatial h+=1; never claim global from scoped UNSAT.
